title: Scope search_literature to survey retrieval
description: Prevents arc_search_literature from being used as a concrete paper lookup tool by tightening its schema description and adding a generic guard for named/versioned/identifier-like queries.
changes: Clarify that arc_search_literature is for topic-level literature survey, related work, and benchmark landscape retrieval.
Add a generic query-shape guard for short named papers, versioned paper names, arXiv IDs, and DOI-like inputs.
Return a structured wrong_tool_for_specific_paper_lookup message instead of weakly related candidate lists for exact-paper lookup attempts.

rollback.notes: Restore the previous arc_search_literature description and remove the concrete-paper query guard.
